items.title: Finland updates list of participating jurisdictions for automatic financial account information exchange
items.summary: Finland’s tax administration published an updated list of participating jurisdictions for the automatic exchange of financial account information under DAC2, the CRS MCAA, and bilateral automatic exchange agreements on 9 September 2026. The list of 121 participating jurisdictions are: Netherlands, Andorra, Anguilla, Antigua and Barbuda, United Arab Emirates, Argentina, Aruba, Australia, Azerbaijan, Bahamas, Bahrain, Barbados,...

Namibia: NIPDB investment guide highlights corporate tax measures, transfer pricing, updated tax framework
items.summary: The Namibia Investment Promotion and Development Board (NIPDB) released the Namibia Investment Guide: Tax Laws in Namibia, Volume 5, on 4 September 2026, detailing the tax laws, compliance framework, and financial regulations governing investors and entities in Namibia.
